charge_port.notes: Estimated: no page names the IQL port; same CCS1 as the 2026 IQ on the shared platform. IQL is a 2026 model with CCS1 (GM: NACS only from model year 2027). Canadian car assumed the same. Canada: no Canadian page read; assumed the same as the US car (owner check).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM says every GM EV of model year 2026 or earlier except the Optiq needs the GM NACS adapter (US page, lists Escalade IQ and IQL). Canada: GM sells the same C$310 adapter for its CCS1 EVs (Guide Auto names Lyriq, not the Escalade IQ), so the Canadian car is assumed the same. Model year 2026. Canada: no Canadian page read; assumed the same as the US car (owner check).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Cars.com says 11.5 kW is standard and 19.2 kW available on the IQL, not per trim; assumed Luxury/Sport carry the standard unit as on the 2026 IQ. IQL: 11.5 kW standard, 19.2 kW available (Cars.com, relaying Cadillac). Which trims get 19.2 kW is not stated; Luxury and Sport assumed 11.5 like the 2026 IQ.

range_km.notes: Cadillac: up to 460 miles (Wards, Cars.com, US) and up to 740 km (CarGurus.ca, Canada). Guide Auto says about 724 km (conflict, not used). Manufacturer estimate, not an EPA/NRCan rating (B97).
